_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.no_cards: Ha ho na likarete hona joale.
player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Motho a le mong vs Dealer

📖 GAME OVERVIEW:
• U qala le {start_chips} chips
• Deki e le ngoe ea kaarte 52 (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• U bapala khahlanong le dealer (ntlo)
• Raundi e ngoe e latela mokgwa wa Ultimate Texas Hold'em: u beha tšimo ea ANTE le BLIND, u fumana kaarte 2, u kgetha ho beha tšimo ea PLAY kapa che, u bontša kaarte tsa setšhaba le u bapatsa letsoho la hao le letsoho la dealer. Sepheo sa hao ke ho eketseha tšimo ea hao (ha u na letsoho le betere), ha u fokotsa tšimo ea hao (ha u na letsoho le mpe).
• Game e fela ha u fihla 0 chips kapa tlase ho tloha ha raundi (LOSS) kapa u phetha raundi 1000 le chips (WIN)

💰 BETTING STRUCTURE:
• ANTE: Tšimo e sa reroang ${ante} raundi e ngoe le ngoe
• BLIND: Tšimo e sa reroang ${ante} raundi e ngoe le ngoe
• PLAY: Tšimo e kgethegileng. Raundi e ngoe le ngoe, u ka kgetha feela e ngoe ya tse latelang: (${ante4} ha e etswa PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} ha e etswa FLOP, kapa ${ante} ha e etswa RIVER. U ka kgetha ho folda ha river, u lahleha letsoho, u sa beha tšimo.)

🎴 CARD DEALING:
• U fumana kaarte 2 (kaarte ea hao)
• Dealer u fumana kaarte 2 (e sa bonahaleng)
• Kaarte 5 tsa setšhaba di behilwe ka pele
• Kaarte tsa setšhaba di bontšwa ka mokgwa o fapaneng

🏆 DEALER QUALIFICATION:
• Dealer o tlameha ho ba le letsoho la PAIR (kaarte 2 tsa mofuta o le mong) ho kgethegileng, a sebelisa kaarte 2 tsa hae le kaarte 5 tsa setšhaba.
• Kgetho ea dealer e ama matokeo a tšimo, joalo ka ha e tla hlalosoa hamorao.

🎮 GAME PHASES & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Mesebetsi: [4x] (${ante4}) kapa [check]
  • [4x]: Beha ${ante4} PLAY tšimo, bontša kaarte 3 tsa setšhaba
  • [check]: Tšimo e sa behwa, bontša kaarte 3 tsa setšhaba

📋 FLOP:
  • Ha 4x tšimo e behilwe: Feelan [skip] e teng (auto-bontša kaarte 2 tsa setšhaba)
  • Ha 4x tšimo e sa behwa: [2x] (${ante2}) kapa [check]
  • [2x]: Beha ${ante2} PLAY tšimo, bontša kaarte 2 tsa setšhaba
  • [check]: Tšimo e sa behwa, bontša kaarte 2 tsa setšhaba

📋 RIVER:
  • Ha 4x kapa 2x tšimo e behilwe: Feelan [skip] e teng (auto-elella ho showdown)
  • Ha PLAY tšimo e sa behwa: [1x] (${ante}) kapa [fold]
  • [1x]: Beha ${ante} PLAY tšimo, elella ho showdown
  • [fold]: Lahleha letsoho, lahleha tšimo ea ANTE le BLIND

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Kaarte zohle di bontšwa le di hlaloswa
  • Letsoho le betere la kaarte 5 la 7 kaarte (2 kaarte + 5 kaarte tsa setšhaba)
  • Tšimo e busetswa ho latela mokgwa wa tšimo

💎 BET PAYOUTS:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer a sa kgethegileng: PUSH (tšimo e busetswa)
  • Dealer a kgethegileng & u win: 1:1 payout (tšimo + tšimo e won)
  • Dealer a kgethegileng & u lose: Tšimo e lahlehileng
  • Tie: PUSH (tšimo e busetswa)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • E sa ameha ke kgetho ea dealer
  • U win: Tšimo e busetswa le tšimo e eketsehileng ho latela bokgabane ba letsoho la hao
  • U lose: Tšimo e lahlehileng
  • Tie: PUSH (tšimo e busetswa)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Tšimo e sa eketseheng

📊 PLAY BET:
  • E sa ameha ke kgetho ea dealer
  • Papiso e ngoe le ngoe: Letsoho la hao le letsoho la dealer
  • U win: 1:1 payout (tšimo + tšimo e won)
  • U lose: Tšimo e lahlehileng
  • Tie: PUSH (tšimo e busetswa)

🎯 POKER HAND RANKINGS (Best to Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 tsa mofuta o le mong
  2. Straight Flush: Kaarte 5 tse latelang tsa mofuta o le mong
  3. Four of a Kind: Kaarte 4 tsa mofuta o le mong
  4. Full House: 3 tsa mofuta o le mong + 2 tsa mofuta o le mong
  5. Flush: Kaarte 5 tsa mofuta o le mong
  6. Straight: Kaarte 5 tse latelang
  7. Three of a Kind: Kaarte 3 tsa mofuta o le mong
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs tsa mofuta o fapaneng
  9. One Pair: Kaarte 2 tsa mofuta o le mong
  10. High Card: Kaarte e kgolo e win

⌨️  ACTION COMMANDS:
• [4x] kapa [play bet 4x]: Beha ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY tšimo
• [2x] kapa [play bet 2x]: Beha ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY tšimo
• [1x] kapa [play bet 1x]: Beha ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY tšimo
• [check] kapa [c]: Check (tšimo e sa behwa)
• [fold] kapa [f]: Fold (lahleha letsoho)
• [skip] kapa [s]: Skip ho phase e latelang (ha mesebetsi e sa hlokahale)

💡 STRATEGY TIPS:
• Letsoho le matla (pairs, kaarte e kgolo) le kanna le etsa 4x tšimo
• Hlahloba kgetho ea dealer - letsoho le mpe le kanna le busetse ha dealer a sa kgethegileng
• BLIND tšimo e kanna e ba profitable le letsoho le matla (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Hlahloba tšimo ea hao! Ha e fihla 0 kapa tlase ho tloha ha raundi, u lahleha.

⚠️  IMPORTANT NOTES:
• ANTE le BLIND tšimo di sa reroang raundi e ngoe le ngoe
• PLAY tšimo e kgethegileng le e strategic
• Hlahloba hore u kenye mesebetsi e ngoe le ngoe, le feela e ngoe mesebetsi ka nako.
